patch.value: Validate selected GitHub issue forms before export

Acceptance: compile explicitly selected repository issue forms into required dropdown/text answers, supported validators and explicit pm-field bindings; refuse unsupported constructs; missing answers produce zero remote writes and one bounded repair checklist. Provide typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, docs and example, non-git real public tracker validation, seeded model-based tests and unchanged npm/Bun CI release gates.

All required dropdown and text inputs accounted for; unsupported constructs explicitly refused; missing required answers yield zero remote writes and one bounded repair checklist; typed SDK/CLI and compact output; docs/example; non-git public tracker proof; seeded properties; npm and Bun release gates unchanged.
